column2: Continue this shot seamlessly: the swirling purple and teal mandala slowly opens outward like petals and the round cartoon plane with propellers flies out of its centre, the mandala colours thinning into a dusk sky over a highway where two of the same cartoon planes appear side by side. Same flat hand-drawn style, no text, no new characters.

Continue this shot seamlessly: the two cartoon planes dancing over the highway at dusk bank away, one fades into the distance as the sky darkens to a starry night with a full moon and a single plane cruises on. Same flat hand-drawn style, gentle camera drift, no text, no new characters.

Continue this shot seamlessly, dreamlike Waking Life rotoscope: the grey-bearded man in a navy coat in front of a city skyline and water tower stays the same man as the skyline melts and flows into a cosy living room where he sits in a red armchair under a quilt beside a round window; the words fade away. Same man throughout, no other people.

Continue this shot seamlessly, dreamlike Waking Life rotoscope: the grey-bearded man waving behind a news desk stays the same man as the studio dissolves into an open road at dusk between theatre curtains, where he floats upward above the road; the words fade away. Same man throughout, no new people.

Continue this shot seamlessly, dreamlike Waking Life rotoscope: the grey-bearded man walking a wire under a dusk sky stays the same man as the sky swirls into soft murky teal clouds and the camera moves close to his smiling face; the words fade away. Same man throughout, no other people.

Continue this shot seamlessly, dreamlike Waking Life rotoscope: the murky teal clouds around the grey-bearded man's face clear away and the camera pulls back to reveal him sitting in a wooden lecture hall full of seated students facing a green chalkboard. Same man throughout, the words fade away, no garbled text.

Continue this shot seamlessly, Waking Life rotoscope: a slow smooth camera push-in across the wooden lecture hall to the grey-bearded man in a navy coat, who stands and gestures at the green chalkboard covered in chalk scribbles. Same man, same room, the title words fade away, no new text.

Continue this shot seamlessly, Waking Life rotoscope: the cream paper panel swings open like a page turning and reveals the grey-bearded man in close-up against a dark blue night sky, smiling as he talks. Same man throughout, the words fade away, no new text, no other people.

Continue this shot seamlessly, cute flat kawaii watercolour: the little bearded man in a navy coat floating among clouds and paper notes drifts down as the soft clouds gather around him and settle into a cosy bed with a lilac blanket under a round night window with a sleepy moon, where he falls asleep. Keep his simple dot-eye face exactly the same, no new characters, no text.
